# FLX-3711: a calibration patch operation cannot be applied to its document

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

A calibration patch holds RFC 6902 replace operations on declared numbers, and a replace needs its target to exist, so it adds nothing. The operation is applied to the text of the document, which keeps every other byte as it was, and that is possible only for a number written as a single plain or quoted scalar in a document that uses no alias or merge key. A pointer that reaches no member, a value that is a mapping, a list or a block scalar, and a document that aliases values are refused, and the message names the document and the pointer. Nothing was written.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3711
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
